title: Celestial Bear Waterfall
description: A large brown bear with multiple circular holes in its body stands against a starry black background. Blue water pours from its glowing white eyes and from holes in its head and torso, cascading into a swirling vortex below, while transparent bubbles containing a mushroom, flame, flowers and a small figure float nearby. White line-art dragonflies and forest plants appear around the flowing water.
